clips.title: The story
paras: In the Barrens, Kodo Horns are gathered from the roaming kodos. Tonga Runetotem uses them in herbal remedies for poisoned wildlife.

Across the Barrens, Tonga Runetotem uses intact kodo horns in his herbal remedies. He works from the Crossroads, where the horns help strengthen his salves. Chips and fragments lack the strength he needs, so he gathers whole horns from mature kodos wandering the plains.
